newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 12,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 12,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.

text.p: Syria's general establishment for cereal processing and trade (GECPT) has offered 12,000 tonnes of lentils for export, an official spokesman said on Friday.
He told Reuters an international call for prices setting February 18 as the final date to receive bids had been issued. Confirmation would be on February 19.
The spokesman said the lentils would be ready for shipment between 15 March and 15 April.
Partial offers would be acceptable up to 1,000 tonnes and the establishment has the right to partial confirmation, he said.
